offer.teaser: Officer Rusk broke the rule he had made himself and wrote an adult wording into the green journal: the flowering asking again, blood over the roots until the plant is still. The plant answered him for the first time in the book's history, though not with anything a book can hear — the whole crown and the open flower turned down to the wet soil under his hand — and the third morning came with both his eyes in his face, because the line he had written was finished before he cut. Now the farm owns a page it can always pay, the sign over the shelf has not changed by a stroke, and the flower that looked at the lamps for four days is looking at the ground and will not look up.
